image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a laminated restaurant menu. The menu features a green border and displays food items with accompanying photographs and text descriptions. The visible section highlights a dish labeled 'STAKES&RR' (likely a misspelling of Steaks or similar) with a price list on the right. Above it, another section shows two other dishes. A red plastic utensil handle is visible at the top edge. The lighting causes significant glare on the laminated surface.
